run_prepare_multitask_input: run the script to preprocess a text file for the multi-task pretrained model
run_prepare_multitask_input_cli: run the CLI tool with --input and --output flags to transform question text files
build_multitask_input_formatter: build a text file formatter that prepends special tokens to each line for model input
refactor_prepare_multitask_input: refactor the script to support additional special token prefixes for different model tasks
review_prepare_multitask_input: review the script that reads text files and prepends s2s_qd_a startQuestion tokens to each line
